projects.title: AI Lead Qualification & CRM Automation
projects.description: An n8n workflow that receives web-form leads, normalizes incoming data, uses an OpenAI model to assign a Hot, Warm, or Cold priority, records the result in Google Sheets, sends an acknowledgement email, and notifies the team according to lead priority.
projects.contribution: My contribution: I designed and configured the workflow steps and the connections between the form, OpenAI, Google Sheets, and Gmail.
projects.outcome: Result: A repeatable lead-triage workflow that records lead scores in one spreadsheet and sends priority-based notifications. No unverified time-saving or conversion figures are claimed.

projects.title: AI Customer Support Email Agent
projects.description: An n8n email workflow that receives customer inquiries through Gmail, cleans and validates message data, prepares an AI-assisted response, routes cases for human review or an eligible automated reply, and logs outcomes in Google Sheets.
projects.imageAlt: AI customer support email workflow screenshot
projects.contribution: My contribution: I designed and configured the email intake, validation, AI response, review-routing, and logging steps.
projects.outcome: Result: A structured email-support workflow with validation, AI-assisted drafts, human-review routing, and a record of handled inquiries.

projects.title: AQSA POS System Testing
projects.status: Completed testing exercise · 100 test cases documented
projects.description: Manual functional testing of a point-of-sale application across sales, inventory, customer records, reports, integrations, and backup workflows. The submitted test record contains 100 test cases.
projects.notes: The attached evidence includes the original report sign-off page and a chart based on the test totals recorded in the checklist.
projects.contribution: My contribution: I executed and documented test cases, compared expected and actual results, and recorded outcomes and limitations.
projects.outcome: Result: A documented test record covering 100 test cases, including expected-versus-actual comparisons and recorded outcomes. Supporting evidence is available as a PDF.
